title: Tenebre facte sunt (Gaspar)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Tenebre facte sunt. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0417), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. IV. Motets, 2010); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2008, Pavanello, Agnese. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.

poly.lyr: Te- ne- bre . . fa- cte, fa- . . . cte sunt, O bo- ne . Je- . su, dum te cru- ci- fi- xis- . . sent Ju- . . . de- . . i; et cir- ca ho- ram no- . . nam ex- cla- ma- . sti vo- ce ma- . . . . gna: De- us, De- us me- us, ut quid de- re- li- qui- sti me? Et in- cli- na- to ca- . . pi- te, e- mi- si- . . sti . spi- ri- tum. Cum er- go ac- ce- pis- ses a- ce- tum . di- xi- . . . sti: con- su- ma- tum est.
